input.subject: Missing documents for supplier registration
input.body:
Dear Sara,

Thank you for your registration documents. We received your VAT certificate, bank letter and GOSI certificate. To complete onboarding, two documents are missing:

- Commercial registration: not received. Please send a copy.
- Zakat certificate: not received. Please send a copy.

Please reply to this email with both documents attached.

Best regards,
Procurement Team
